newsitem.title: USA: Mediscience's Hugill to step down as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Mediscience's Hugill to step down as CEO.

text.p: Mediscience Technology Corp said on Wednesday Herbert Hugill will step down as president and chief executive at the end of the month.
Hugill, who was just named to the posts on Jan 23, will continue as a Mediscience board member and as a consultant to help develop and negotiate certain business relationships.
Peter Katevatis, Mediscience's chairman, will return to the additional post of chief executive, the company said.
Mediscience, which owns exclusive rights to 15 patents in the field of biomedical optics, was not immediately available to comment on Hugill's one-week tenure.
